title: Octorato Skill Manifest
description: Machine-readable manifest for a distributable package (Milestone M5 Distribution; v8 PACKAGE primitive). Lets a stranger safely install a versioned skill: identity (name), vintage (semver version), terms (license), the privileged actions it declares (capabilities), the hash of its own tree (tree_sha256) and the detached signature over this file (signature). additionalProperties is false so typos surface instead of being silently ignored. Schema evolution happens via v1 → v2 (new $id path).

kind.description: What this manifest describes. 'skill' is signed, vendored under skills/vendor/<name> and symlinked into the discovery path. 'arm' is a client repo: validated and registered, never signed (an arm is the operator's own repo, so a signature would be the operator signing to himself). Absent means skill.

tree_sha256.description: sha256 over every file in the package except this manifest and its detached signature, feeding '<posix relpath>\u0000<sha256 of the bytes>\u0000' per file in sorted path order. Computed and checked by scripts/octo_pkg.py. Required for an installable skill package; absent on an in-repo manifest, whose tree changes on every edit.

signature.description: Metadata about the DETACHED signature over this manifest, which lives beside it in skill.json.sig. The bytes are never inlined here: the signature covers this file, so it cannot be inside it. Because the manifest carries tree_sha256, a valid signature over the manifest is a signature over the tree.

namespace.description: ssh-keygen -Y namespace the signature was made under. Always octorato-pkg.

signer.description: Allowed-signers principal expected to verify it, e.g. octorato-release.

file.description: Relative path of the detached signature. Always skill.json.sig.

name.description: Skill slug — lowercase kebab-case, matches the skills/<name>/ directory.

version.description: Semantic version (semver 2.0.0). Required so installs are reproducible and upgradeable.

license.description: SPDX license identifier (e.g. MIT, Apache-2.0, AGPL-3.0-only) or 'proprietary'.

description.description: One-line summary, mirrors the skill's front-matter description.

capabilities.description: Privileged tools/actions the skill declares it needs (from the capability vocabulary). Lets an installer reason about the blast radius before trusting the skill.

dependencies.description: Other skills this skill requires, keyed by skill slug → semver range string.
